newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO TUMBLE AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO TUMBLE AT FIXING.

text.p: The top three most heavily capitalised Czech shares fell to year lows on the PX50 index at Tuesday's fixing as the sustained slide in the fortunes of Czech equities gathered pace.
SPT Telecom led the way falling 97 crowns, or 3.0 percent, to 3,148. Power utility CEZ fell 20 crowns to 920 and Komercni Banka dropped 32 crowns to to 2,040.

Dealers said there were no new reasons for the declines, citing poor first quarter earnings, the general state of the Czech capital markets and uncertain prospects for the economy as a whole as the main factors behind the current slump.
